newsitem.title: NORWAY: Hydro Magnesium weighs Canadian expansion.
newsitem.headline: Hydro Magnesium weighs Canadian expansion.

text.p: Norway's Hydro Magnesium said on Thursday it was considering an expansion at its operation in Becancour, Canada.

A statement said an expansion study initiated in 1995 had now been completed and had demonstrated "technical viability and economic attractiveness for a series of multiple-step expansions of 10,000 MT to 15,000 MT each".
"The project is now moving into a technology assessment period to verify some elements involving new process technology," the statement said. "No date has been set for an expansion."
Hydro Magnesium is a subsidiary of industrial conglomerate Norsk Hydro ASA. --Oslo newsroom +47 22 42 50 41
